composition.method: symmetric V(dt/2) G(dt) V(dt/2) Strang composition
composition.state_dependent_coefficients: recomputed only at declared substep boundaries; no hidden lagging inside a substep

field_decomposition.transport_coordinates: surface mass, radial momentum, angular momentum, total energy, five STF shear amplitudes

proof_kernel.abstract_nine_field_Godunov_block: the certified vertical-equilibrium restriction of the eleven-field quadratic normal form

transport_generator.height_policy: H is a frozen positive coefficient during each hyperbolic transport substep
transport_generator.requirements: A_G^0 positive definite; A_G^r symmetric; full radial spectrum real and strictly causal
transport_generator.shear_completion: a prospective five-STF common potential in the nine-field transport block only

vertical_port_generator.energy_ledger: reversible pressure/gravity work plus kinetic work is zero; gamma_H*P_H**2/surface_mass is deposited as heat
vertical_port_generator.entropy_ledger: reversible contribution is zero and damping produces gamma_H*P_H**2/(surface_mass*T)>=0
